```
['run the resynthesis script to encode audio into discrete units and resynthesize it back', 'build a SpeechEncoder from pretrained dense and quantizer model names with a given vocab size', 'encode an audio waveform into a stream of deduplicated discrete units using a SpeechEncoder', 'resynthesize discrete units back into audio using a TacotronVocoder and save the output', 'calculate the uniform and unigram bits-per-second compression rate for encoded discrete units']
```
